# Getting help

Melee for New 3DS is a free hobby project made in spare time. Help works best when it starts with facts.

## Before asking

- **Builder stopped?** Read the yellow message in its window; it usually says what to fix (internet, PC date, disk space, antivirus). Run the builder again afterwards: it continues where it stopped. [READ ME FIRST](../native-3ds/tools/easy_build/READ%20ME%20FIRST.txt) lists the common fixes.
- **Slippi Direct beta?** Read the [Slippi beta guide](../native-3ds/docs/slippi/SLIPPI_BETA.md) first (troubleshooting, and how it differs from Slippi on a PC). Report bugs with the "Slippi beta problem" form, never to the Slippi team.
- **Game problem?** See [If something is wrong](../native-3ds/docs/HOME_MENU.md#if-something-is-wrong) and the [project status](../native-3ds/docs/PORT_STATUS.md) for known limits.

## Where to post

- **A bug you can describe with a log:** [open an issue](https://github.com/2gifts/melee-3ds/issues/new/choose) and fill in the form. Builder problems need `build-log.txt`; game problems need steps to reproduce and `SD:/3ds/melee/game.log`.
- **Ideas, requests, questions:** [Discussions](https://github.com/2gifts/melee-3ds/discussions).

## What gets closed

- Issues without the requested log or steps (after a reminder).
- Requests for prebuilt CIA or 3DSX files. They contain Nintendo's game and will not be shared.
- Complaints, demands and insults. Be kind: nobody here is paid.
